---
title: "Montage Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 3
    number_sections: true
    latex_engine: xelatex
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  report_data: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "95%"
)
rd <- params$report_data
manifest <- rd$manifest
panels <- rd$panels
layout <- rd$params$layout
is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
qc <- rd$qc %||% data.frame()
fmt <- neuromosaic::montage_report_formatters(
  manifest = manifest,
  layout = layout,
  is_html = is_html,
  intro = rd$intro,
  section_notes = rd$section_notes,
  interludes = rd$interludes,
  groups = rd$groups,
  map_selector = rd$params$map_selector %||% "auto",
  panels = rd$panels
)
interactive_hooks <- neuromosaic::montage_interactive_report_hooks(
  rd$interactive, is_html = is_html
)
surface_hooks <- neuromosaic::montage_surface_report_hooks(
  rd$surface, is_html = is_html
)
```

```{r report-overview, results='asis'}
fmt$emit_report_styles()
fmt$emit_report_header(rd$params$title, format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
fmt$emit_intro()
if (!is_html) fmt$emit_report_overview()
fmt$emit_qc_summary(qc)
interactive_hooks$emit_document()
surface_hooks$emit_document()
```

```{r interactive-surface, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(rd$surface_scene)) {
  cat("# Interactive surface\n\n")
  if (is_html) {
    neurosurf::surfwidget(
      rd$surface_scene,
      width = "100%",
      height = "600px"
    )
  } else {
    cat(rd$surface_scene@fallback, "\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r summary-matrix, results='asis'}
if (length(rd$groups) > 1L) {
  cat("# Summary\n\n")
  fmt$emit_summary_matrix()
}
```

# Maps

```{r montage-panels, results='asis'}
fmt$emit_maps_controls()
emit_map_body <- function(i) {
  row <- manifest[i, , drop = FALSE]
  map_id <- as.character(row$map_id[[1]])
  label <- as.character(row$label[[1]])
  panel <- panels[[map_id]] %||% list()

  fmt$emit_interludes(map_id, "before")
  if ("description" %in% names(row) &&
      !is.na(row$description[[1]]) &&
      nzchar(row$description[[1]])) {
    cat(row$description[[1]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  fmt$emit_metadata(row)
  fmt$emit_panel_qc(panel$qc)

  # Say up front when nothing survives, before the (blank) panels.
  empty_table <- is.data.frame(panel$table) && nrow(panel$table) == 0L
  if (empty_table) fmt$emit_table(panel$table, row)

  volume_image <- panel$volume_image %||% panel$volume_image_path
  surface_image <- panel$surface_image %||% panel$surface_image_path
  alt_stem <- paste0(
    if ("analysis_label" %in% names(row)) paste0(row$analysis_label[[1]], ", ") else "",
    label
  )
  fmt$emit_panel_image(volume_image, paste(alt_stem, "volume montage"),
                       empty = empty_table)
  fmt$emit_panel_image(surface_image, paste(alt_stem, "surface montage"),
                       empty = empty_table)

  if (!empty_table) fmt$emit_table(panel$table, row)
  fmt$emit_interludes(map_id, "after")
}

if (nrow(manifest) == 0L) {
  cat("*No maps to display.*\n")
} else {
  for (group in rd$groups) {
    rows <- match(group$map_ids, manifest$map_id)
    if (is_html && length(rows) > 1L) {
      fmt$emit_group_start(group, rows[[1]], rows)
      for (j in seq_along(rows)) {
        i <- rows[[j]]
        fmt$emit_variant_start(manifest[i, , drop = FALSE], group, j)
        emit_map_body(i)
        fmt$emit_variant_end()
      }
      fmt$emit_group_end()
    } else {
      for (i in rows) {
        fmt$emit_panel_heading(i, as.character(manifest$label[[i]]))
        emit_map_body(i)
      }
    }
    interactive_hooks$emit_host(as.character(group$analysis_id))
    surface_hooks$emit_host(as.character(group$analysis_id))
  }
}
```

# Provenance

```{r provenance, results='asis'}
prov <- rd$provenance
if (is.null(prov)) {
  cat("*No provenance metadata available.*\n")
} else {
  prov_fields <- vapply(names(prov), function(field) {
    value <- prov[[field]]
    if (is.null(value) || length(value) != 1L) "" else as.character(value)
  }, character(1))
  prov_fields <- prov_fields[nzchar(prov_fields)]
  if (length(prov_fields) == 0L) {
    cat("*No scalar provenance metadata available.*\n")
  } else {
    prov_tbl <- data.frame(
      Field = names(prov_fields),
      Value = unname(prov_fields),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    cat(knitr::kable(prov_tbl, format = "pipe"), sep = "\n")
  }
}
```

# Session Info

```{r session-info, results='asis'}
session_text <- paste(utils::capture.output(print(sessionInfo())), collapse = "\n")
if (is_html) {
  cat("<details class=\"nm-details\"><summary>R session details</summary>\n<pre><code>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(session_text), "</code></pre></details>\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("```\n", session_text, "\n```\n", sep = "")
}
```
